line_oozes_engine.save_rule: Spend out every turn, because a meal now compounds through the Soup. The one save: on the turn before a scheduled tier-up, keep 3 gold so the climb and a meal fit the same turn. After tier 6, spend everything; every 3 spare gold buys a stomach meal.
placement: Until a Digest Ooze is on your board, buy Little Dollop ahead of Stone Soup and allow off-tribe bodies. Once the Digest carry is down, use the listed priority order.

After the board is set, put the biggest non-Ooze shop unit into the carry (the biggest Digest Ooze with room); use the Dollop's discount while the carry is a Dollop. From R12, the Slice is the carry's meal when it is bigger than the best shop unit; otherwise play it over the smallest support.
When Bubble and Squeak or Frumenty arrives, put the empty Dollop into it, unless the Dollop is golden.

From R8, keep a fresh Little Dollop as a second stomach in front of Aspic; one 2-gold meal a turn; the carry eats it every 3 turns, unless the next opponent's scout shows a biggest-enemy answer, then keep both.

With Aspic: carry F2, second stomach F1, Aspic B1, Nell B2. Without Aspic: carry B2, Nell B1 or B3. Moss, Soup and Elder fill the rest. Keep one slot beside the carry free for the split when there is a spare body. From R13, Granny in an unbroken run.
Buy and keep it empty when the next opponent's biggest unit holds 35% or more of its board; otherwise use its Belly as a spare life.
Freeze only a wanted low-tier unit (a triple or Figgy copy) to keep it from Nell; otherwise let Nell eat.

line_oozes_tempo.save_rule: Never save. Spare gold buys reserves into front Bellies, Ooze reserves first.
placement: Until a Digest Ooze is on your board, buy Little Dollop ahead of Stone Soup and allow off-tribe bodies. Once the Digest carry is down, use the listed priority order.
The pot (Bubble and Squeak in B2) gets one non-Ooze meal a turn; Nell stands beside it.
Fill front Bellies (Pie, Wobbly, Posset) with the biggest spare units; the last in is the biggest.
Pot B2, Nell B3, Soup B1; Pie, Moss and Elder in front; from R12 Granny F2 with every slot occupied so the run is unbroken.
Swap Hasty in for the Pie or Moss when the scout shows a carry of 35% or more; keep it empty.
Play each Slice over the smallest support; never feed it to the pot.
